serverInfo.name: Mellow Fellow
serverInfo.description: Mellow Fellow — South Florida hemp-derived cannabis brand founded in 2019 by a PhD chemist and a licensed pharmacist. Specializes in mood-specific cannabinoid blending (Destination Series). 250+ products: vapes, carts, gummies, THCa flower, concentrates, drinks. Ships USA-wide.

transport.note: Static site — no live MCP endpoint is hosted. Resources below are plain HTML pages, not JSON-RPC tools. Ordering is human-assisted only (WhatsApp/email).
